# Shravan Bharathulwar

> AI and data leader in global finance and Art of Living meditation teacher who builds AI tools for wellbeing. Canonical name: Shravan Bharathulwar (also written Shravan V. Bharathulwar; the family wellness practice uses Shravan Bharathula).

## Facts
- Current role: Senior Director and Fellow, AI Hub, BNY (New York), since April 2026.
- Previous role: Director, Data Strategy and Architecture, RBC Capital Markets, December 2016 to April 2026. Defined a common trade data standard and led data strategy for analytics and regulatory reporting; began building AI tools in 2024.
- Earlier: Headstrong (Risk and Compliance Practice Lead, 2003-2012), Algorithmics (IBM), JPMorgan Chase, Nomura; consulting to Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Credit Suisse, Scotiabank. Taught at Rishi Valley School (2000-2001).
- Education: undergraduate degree, IIT Bombay; M.S. Electrical and Computer Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University; Applied AI and Data Science Program, MIT Professional Education (2024); Advanced Financial Risk Management certificate, IIM Bangalore; FRM (GARP).
- Talks: "AI-Powered CDM Navigator", FINOS Open Source in Finance Forum, New York, 2025; "Fueling AI with the Right Data", AI in Financial Services USA (CeFPro).
- Meditation: learned SKY Breath Meditation about 30 years ago as an undergraduate at IIT Bombay; Art of Living teacher since 2006: Art of Living Part 1 (SKY Breath Meditation), Part 2 (Art of Silence), Sahaj Samadhi Meditation, Sri Sri Yoga, Sleep and Anxiety Protocol, and Know Your Child. Completed 300-hour Advanced Yoga Teacher Training, Sri Sri School of Yoga.
- Builds AI tools in volunteer time that help a global meditation community, and the "Art of Living Meditation Mentor" custom GPT.
